description: This file defines a custom exception class `NotOfficeSpecificProductException`, which extends an abstract exception class used within the Fineract platform to indicate domain rule violations related to products not being specific to an office.

classes.name: NotOfficeSpecificProductException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception thrown when a product is not specific to an office, indicating a domain rule violation.

methods.name: NotOfficeSpecificProductException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating that the product with a given productId is not an office-specific product in the specified officeId.

calls: super(String message, String defaultUserMessage, Object... parameters)
